info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Transaction Processing API
info.description: The Customer Account Transaction Processing API facilitates real-time transaction updates for designated customer accounts. Through this endpoint, businesses can push transaction notifications for specific accounts, enhancing communication and financial tracking. This functionality is critical for financial institutions and service providers that require timely updates on account activity. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial dashboards that need to replicate transactions in a user-friendly format.

post.summary: Push a transaction to a customer's account.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to push a transaction to a specified account of a customer. It facilitates easy transaction processing and helps in maintaining accurate financial records for accounts.
